parameters: Oh!! Is there someone here? I can't see very well.
A feminine voice echoes from the dripping pipe.
Hi! Hello! Oh, how I'm glad to speak to someone *normal*.
You're the second normal guy I hear in days, everyone
else was either a monster or crazy. Usually both.
So... I'm in a bit of a tight spot, as you can see.
You have both the pen and stationery! Great!
You have something I can write on? Great!
I have everything I need. Hang on. Give me a few minutes.
I'm done. Can you please give this to him, if you find him?
A lightly curved envelope is pushed out of the pipe.
It is stained with some greasy fluid.
I hope I can see him again...
Have you seen Nestor? I hope he likes my letter...
How did you end up like this?
How did you end up like this?
I'm not entirely sure. I think I fell asleep stargazing
out my window. This was a few days ago.
When I woke up, everything felt wrong.
I was still in my bedroom, but it looked different.
I thought I was having a nightmare.
My door was gone too, replaced by a dark tunnel.
It was wide enough to walk inside... so I went in.
It narrowed more and more as it went on.
At one point I could only crawl on all fours.
Then, I got on my belly. It got tighter and tighter...
Not entirely. I'm still slowly inching along, but it's
been very slow, and I've been feeling weird. Like I'm
being squeezed out of a toothpaste tube.
I can see the light at the end of the tunnel, but
I'm not sure I'm going to like what comes out the
Promise me you won't judge if I come out as a blob
There was a guy before you. Nestor.
Could you find me some stationnary, and a pen?
I'd like to write him something...
I don't have a lot of room in here, but I'll manage.
What remains of Nestor doesn't seem to be paying you any
mind. Should you follow the other parts that fled?
